composition: Extreme close-up of king's closed eyes and listening ear, rain streaks window, grey blanket.

View from BEHIND the frail standing king at the window, his hand against cold stone mullion large foreground; low storm clouds fork lightning toward distant earth; apprentice small reflection/edge, empty chair behind. Grey wool blanket draped over shoulders. No lightning indoors.

Low wide-angle view from sunlight on stone floor looking up toward standing frail king at window, hand on frame, grey blanket over shoulders, head raised in quiet wonder. Brilliant cloudless blue morning fills most upper image, empty chancellor chair and apprentice behind. Strong warm sunlit diagonal.

Top-down oblique intimate still-life of enormous ancient chronicle on king's grey lap blanket. One aged finger points at FIRST page of illegible marks, red sleeve and ermine. His crowned face looks up toward blue-sky window at upper edge. Apprentice profile edge. No actual town or bridge inside palace. New composition replaces old restoration instruction at user's request.

Close shot from directly above king's OPEN PALMS over grey wool lap blanket, thin hands unsteady and separated, bowed crowned head upper edge, troubled. Apprentice silhouette edge, clear blue daylight. No tags, no lanterns, no objects in palms. Distinct from rubbing hands.

REVERSE view from immediately beside king's shoulder high on dais, gaze follows long EMPTY hall toward distant apprentice alone below, warm late afternoon sun. King tired profile occupies right foreground and empty smaller chair edge left. No spectators or ghosts. Grey lap blanket.

Intimate two-person composition at eye level of kneeling apprentice and king leaning forward with gentle tired eyes, raised advice hand central, one round-headed faceless wooden doll with black iron joints beside apprentice. Empty gold elixir cup set on armrest, grey lap blanket. Calm luminous orange dusk through window, no live Morden.

Macro foreground of SMALL BLACKENED antique lantern on throne armrest under king's gently resting hand; his eyes closed in soft upper background turned toward EMPTY chair, apprentice reporting at side. Clear daylight. No pile of lanterns inside palace, no Morden, no Ordo.

Oblique overhead still life: king holds ONE small wooden tag beside old royal decree with red wax seal, corresponding handwriting ONLY illegible abstract marks. His crowned face looks sideways toward empty chancellor chair, apprentice near edge. Grey blanket, warm late afternoon blue sky. No readable writing.

Very tight low three-quarter portrait of king leaning back, eyes half closed, ONE hand over heart on red robe, pale tired face and beard, grief and quiet acceptance. Empty chancellor chair visible beyond his shoulder in calm orange sunset, apprentice a small bowed silhouette. Grey blanket at lower edge. No lantern removed from tomb, no actual graves indoors.
